drivingQuestion: When blood requiring covering is mixed with other liquids or with other blood, is the obligation of covering still in force?
outcomeNote: A mishna: the anonymous ruling and Rabbi Yehuda's two statements stand side by side without resolution.

segments.he: מַתְנִי׳ דָּם שֶׁנִּתְעָרֵב בְּמַיִם, אִם יֵשׁ בּוֹ מַרְאִית דָּם – חַיָּיב לְכַסּוֹת. נִתְעָרֵב בְּיַיִן – רוֹאִין אוֹתוֹ כְּאִילּוּ הוּא מַיִם. נִתְעָרֵב בְּדַם הַבְּהֵמָה
segments.en: «MISHNA:» In a case of the «blood» of an undomesticated animal or bird «that was mixed with water, if there is in» the mixture «the appearance of blood» one is «obligated to cover» it. If the blood «was mixed with wine one views» the wine «as though it is water,» and if a mixture with that amount of water would have the appearance of blood one is obligated to cover it. Likewise, if the blood of an undomesticated animal or a bird «was mixed with the blood of a domesticated animal,» which one does not have to cover,

segments.he: אוֹ בְּדַם הַחַיָּה – רוֹאִין אוֹתוֹ כְּאִילּוּ הֵן מַיִם. רַבִּי יְהוּדָה אוֹמֵר: אֵין דָּם מְבַטֵּל דָּם.
segments.en: «or with blood of the undomesticated animal» that did not flow from the neck and does not require covering, «one views» the blood «as though it is water. Rabbi Yehuda says: Blood does not nullify blood.» Therefore, even if the undomesticated animal’s blood, which one must cover, is not recognizable in this mixture, he is obligated to cover the mixture nevertheless.

segments.he: דָּם הַנִּיתָּז וְשֶׁעַל הַסַּכִּין – חַיָּיב לְכַסּוֹת. אָמַר רַבִּי יְהוּדָה: אֵימָתַי? בִּזְמַן שֶׁאֵין שָׁם דָּם אֶלָּא הוּא, אֲבָל יֵשׁ שָׁם דָּם שֶׁלֹּא הוּא – פָּטוּר מִלְּכַסּוֹת.
segments.en: With regard to «blood that spurts» outside the pit over which the animal was slaughtered, or onto a wall, «and» blood «that» remained «on the» slaughtering «knife,» one is «obligated to cover» it. «Rabbi Yehuda said: When» is this the halakha? «When no blood» remains «there» from the slaughter «except that» blood. «But» if «blood» remains «there» from the slaughter «that is not that» blood, he is «exempt from covering» it.

moves.summary: Blood mixed with water must be covered if the mixture has the appearance of blood; wine is judged as if it were water.
Blood of a domesticated animal or other blood of the undomesticated animal is likewise judged as if it were water.
moves.about: whether blood requiring covering is nullified when it is mixed with other blood in which it is not recognizable

moves.cueHe: רבי יהודה אומר: אין דם מבטל דם
moves.summary: Rabbi Yehuda holds that blood is never nullified by blood, so the mixture must be covered.
Blood that spurted out and blood on the slaughtering knife must be covered.
moves.about: confining the obligation to cover spurted blood and knife blood to where no other blood from the slaughter remains

moves.summary: Rabbi Yehuda limits that ruling to where no other blood of the slaughter remains.

edges.cueHe: רבי יהודה אומר: אין דם מבטל דם
edges.about: whether blood requiring covering is nullified when it is mixed with other blood in which it is not recognizable

edges.cueHe: אמר רבי יהודה: אימתי? בזמן שאין שם דם אלא הוא
edges.about: confining the obligation to cover spurted blood and knife blood to where no other blood from the slaughter remains
